summary.text: Night Song is Shen Shang's immortal killer move. It spreads a melancholic song that darkens the battlefield and saps the trapped Gu Immortals' will to fight.

claims.text: Chased by Myriad Year Flying Warship, Shen Shang stops in the air and unleashes the immortal killer move Night Song. The song has a slow tempo, focused on vocals with drums and zithers, traditional yet sad; sadness fills the field like a tidal wave. At the periphery, Hua Die and Feng Jiang are already crying, and Miao Ming Shen, Ren Xiu Ping, and the rest wear sad expressions they cannot help. Fang Yuan snorts, and Myriad Year Flying Warship shines with radiance that helps him block the power of night song.

Shen Shang did not activate it to deal with the Gu Immortals directly, but to create a battlefield environment. The song envelops sea and sky; twilight mist spreads from the sound waves, and after a few breaths the entire regret crying sea turns pitch black. The Gu Immortals cannot see anything and hear only the sorrowful night song, their morale and battle intent falling drastically; if that continued they were going to be defenseless. Fang Yuan is barely affected, yet the darkness still costs him sight of his target, so he activates an investigative method to find Shen Shang. Shen Shang senses this and laughs that Fang Yuan fell for his trap, then activates Sensory Injury. Fang Yuan later works out that night song was a trap to lure him into detecting Shen Shang, who then followed that connection to reach him.

Being chased by Myriad Year Flying Warship made it ordinary to use night song to conceal traces. If Fang Yuan had not used an investigative method, Shen Shang would hide in the darkness and would not be able to do anything.
